svg.title: Higher fee first, by client and arrival condition
svg.desc: Share of same-block pairs of our probes (shared fee payer) in which the higher-fee probe is earlier, when it was sent at the same time or later than the lower-fee one. 95% bootstrap intervals. Data: data/ANALYSIS.md.
svg.text: Does the higher-fee transaction still land first if it arrives later? (mainnet, 2026-10-29 UTC)
Share of same-block pairs of our probes (shared fee payer) in which the higher-fee probe is earlier. 100% = ordered by fee, 0% = ordered by arrival,
dashed line = coin flip. Left: probes sent within 1 ms of each other (queued before the slot / arriving mid-block). Right: higher fee sent this many ms later. Bars: 95% CI.
